title: Three7 DFS
text:
What we collect
Your email address. If you sign in or subscribe, we collect your email address. You sign in with a link or code sent to that email; there’s no password.
Subscription and payment details. If you subscribe to Premium, payments are handled by Stripe. Stripe collects your card details and billing information (such as your ZIP or postal code). We never see or store your full card number. From Stripe we see your email, your subscription status (for example, trialing, active or cancelled) and your payment history.
Your saved settings and lineups. If you’re a Premium member, the NFL tool saves your optimizer settings (such as lineup counts, exposures, removed or locked players and projections you’ve edited) and any lineups you choose to save, so they’re there when you come back. They’re linked to your account, and other members can’t see them.
Your saved settings and lineups are encrypted. Our app encrypts them (AES-256) before they’re stored, including the names you give your saved lineups, so they’re unreadable in our database, even to someone browsing it. Lineups are created on our servers when you build them, but we don’t keep a record of them unless you choose to save them.
Our promise: we play DFS ourselves, so we built it this way on purpose. We never view your saved settings or lineups unless you ask us to for support, we never use member data for our own contest entries, and we never share or sell it.
Basic technical information. Like most websites, our hosting providers automatically record standard technical information when you visit, such as your IP address, browser type and the pages you open. We use it to keep the tools running and secure.
Information stored in your browser. When you sign in, our NFL tool saves a sign-in token in your browser so you stay signed in on that device. We don’t use advertising cookies.
We don’t collect your DraftKings or FanDuel account details, and we don’t need them.

title: Three7 DFS
text:
How we use it

To sign you in and keep you signed in
To check whether you have an active Premium subscription and unlock Premium features
To send you sign-in emails and messages about your account or subscription
To answer your questions when you contact us
To keep our tools working, secure and free of abuse
Occasionally, to tell you about new Three7 DFS features. You can opt out at any time by replying “unsubscribe” or emailing us.

We don’t sell your information. We share it only with the companies that help us run Three7 DFS, and only for that purpose:

We may also share information if the law requires it, or to protect our rights or the safety of others.

title: Three7 DFS
text:
How long we keep it
We keep your email and account information while you use Three7 DFS. Saved lineups stay until you delete them in the tool. If you ask us to delete your account, we’ll delete it from our sign-in system along with your saved settings and lineups. Stripe keeps payment records for as long as the law requires.

title: Three7 DFS
text:
Your choices

See or delete your information: email support@three7dfs.com and we’ll respond within 30 days.
Cancel your subscription: use Manage subscription in the NFL tool at any time. You keep Premium until the end of the period you’ve paid for.
Sign out: use Sign out in the tool, or clear your browser’s site data.

title: Three7 DFS
text:
Who can use Three7 DFS
You must be at least 18 years old, or the minimum age to play daily fantasy sports where you live if that’s higher. It’s your responsibility to make sure daily fantasy sports, and tools like ours, are allowed where you are, and to follow the rules of any contest site you play on, such as DraftKings or FanDuel.
Three7 DFS is an independent tool. We’re not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by DraftKings, FanDuel, the NFL, MLB or any team. We don’t run contests, take entry fees or pay out prizes.

title: Three7 DFS
text:
Projections are estimates, not guarantees
Our projections and lineups come from statistical and machine learning models. They’re estimates of what might happen, and real games often turn out differently. Data can be late or wrong, and injury and lineup news can change after projections are made.
We don’t promise that you’ll win any contest or make any money. You decide which lineups to enter and how much to play, and you’re responsible for those decisions and any losses. Nothing on Three7 DFS is financial, betting or professional advice.

title: Three7 DFS
text:
Your account
You sign in with your email address; there’s no password. Keep access to your email secure, because anyone who can read it can sign in as you. Your account is for you alone, so please don’t share it or your Premium access with others.

title: Three7 DFS
text:
Free and Premium
You can use the free version of the NFL tool without signing in. NFL Premium adds more lineups per build, exports, downloads, and saved settings and lineups. We may add, change or remove features over time. If a change takes away something important from Premium, we’ll tell you first.

title: Three7 DFS
text:
Billing, trials and cancellation

Price. Premium costs $10 per month, plus any applicable taxes. Payments are processed by Stripe; we never see your full card number.
Free trial. New subscribers get a 7-day free trial. You won’t be charged during the trial. Unless you cancel before the trial ends, your subscription starts and your card is charged automatically. Free trials are one per person.
Automatic renewal. Premium renews automatically every month and your card is charged at the start of each billing period until you cancel.
Cancelling. You can cancel anytime in the NFL tool under Manage subscription, or by emailing us. When you cancel, you keep Premium until the end of the period you’ve already paid for, and you won’t be charged again.
Refunds. Payments are non-refundable, and we don’t give refunds or credits for partial months, except where the law requires it. If you think you were charged by mistake, email us and we’ll look into it.
Failed payments. If a payment fails, Stripe will try again over the following days. If it still can’t be collected, your subscription ends and your account returns to the free version.
Price changes. We may change the price of Premium. We’ll email you before a new price applies to you, and it will only apply from your next billing period. You can cancel before then if you don’t want to continue.

title: Three7 DFS
text:
Saved settings and lineups
Premium members can save settings and lineups. They belong to you, and we use them only to provide the service. We do our best to keep them safe, but please keep your own copy of anything important (such as by exporting your lineups), because we can’t guarantee that saved data will never be lost.

text:
Acceptable use
When using Three7 DFS, please don’t:

share, sell, republish or redistribute our projections or downloads, or use them to build a competing product
scrape, copy or extract our data with bots or other automated tools
try to get around Premium limits or the sign-in, or access other people’s accounts or data
interfere with or overload the service, or try to break its security
use Three7 DFS for anything illegal

We work to keep Three7 DFS running, especially around game time, but we can’t promise it will always be available, error-free or on time. We may change, pause or stop any part of Three7 DFS. If we permanently shut down Premium, we’ll stop charging you.
